reclaim.name: Reclaim
reclaim.desc: Enemy sources leak glowing ink across the page. Scrub it clean, destroy the sources, and own the field before they do. Ten pages, from open paper to a fortress.

survival.name: Survival
survival.desc: An open page. Hold out to 15:00 and beat The Great Eraser.

burning_page.name: Burning Page
burning_page.desc: The page burns inward. Your ink survives as ground only you made; each strip pays out for the share you owned. Beat The Great Eraser at 10:00.

masterpiece.name: Masterpiece
masterpiece.desc: Paint by number. Dip in the ink wells to change colour and style, fill each numbered area, and keep the horde off your picture. Beat The Great Eraser at 10:00 for up to three stars.
